Ingredients
20 oz ground turkey
16 oz butternut squash
4 scallions
2 cans black beans
2 tomato paste
1 Tex-Mex paste (all)
2 tbsp Southwest spice blend
2 limes
8 tbsp yogurt
1/2 cup white cheddar
Pantry: oil, salt, pepper

1. Wash produce. Chop squash into bite-size pieces. Slice scallions, keeping whites and greens apart. Quarter the lime.
2. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pot over medium-high. Add turkey and Southwest spice. Season with salt and pepper.
3. Cook turkey, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes.
4. Add squash and scallion whites. Stir now and then until scallions soften, 2-4 minutes.
5. Stir in all the tomato paste and all the Tex-Mex paste. Cook until slightly darker, 1-2 minutes.
6. Add the beans with their liquid, 2 cups water, salt and pepper. Bring to a simmer.
7. Simmer, stirring now and then, until chili thickens and squash is tender, 12-15 minutes. Turn off heat.
8. Too thick? Add a splash of water. Season with a squeeze of lime, salt and pepper.
9. Serve in bowls topped with yogurt, scallion greens and the cheddar. Lime wedges on the side.

Ingredients
2 onions
2 poblano peppers (long green peppers)
20 oz ground pork
2 tomatoes
2 limes
12 flour tortillas
2 Tex-Mex paste
2 tbsp Southwest spice blend
8 tbsp sour cream
1 cup Mexican cheese blend
Pantry: olive oil (about 2 tbsp + 1 tsp), salt, pepper

1. Move oven racks to the top and middle positions. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Wash and dry all produce.
2. Core and thinly slice the poblanos into strips. Thinly slice the onions, then finely chop a few slices to make 3 tbsp. Dice the tomatoes. Zest the limes, then quarter them.
3. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high. Add pork and Southwest spice. Brown, breaking it up, 3-4 minutes. Pour off excess grease.
4. Add poblanos and sliced onion. Cook, stirring, until veggies are tender and pork is cooked through, 5-7 minutes.
5. Stir in Tex-Mex paste and 1/3 cup water. Simmer until thickened, 1-2 minutes. Season with pepper. Turn off heat and cover.
6. Coat both sides of the tortillas with 2 tbsp olive oil. Spread over 2 baking sheets. Prick each tortilla a few times with a fork.
7. Bake tortillas on the top and middle racks until the first side is lightly golden, 4-5 minutes. Watch closely, they brown fast.
8. While they bake, make pico: mix tomato, chopped onion, juice of 1 lime, salt and pepper. Make crema: stir sour cream, a squeeze of lime and a pinch of zest. Thin with water, 1 tsp at a time, until drizzly. Salt to taste.
9. Flip tortillas and swap the sheets between racks. Bake until golden on the second side, 4-5 minutes.
10. Sprinkle tortillas with cheese. Return to oven until melted, 1-2 minutes.
11. Plate cheesy tortillas. Top with pork mixture, pico and crema. Serve with lime wedges.

Ingredients
1 lb sirloin steak, cubed
4 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp butter
1 cup green beans

1. Pat the steak dry and season generously with salt and pepper.
2. Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the steak and cook for 5 minutes, turning once, until browned.
3. Add the green beans and cook for 4 minutes until bright green and tender.
4. Lower the heat, add the butter and garlic, and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
5. Plate the steak and beans, spoon over the garlic butter, and enjoy!
